name: fight15-s30
title: Ending the session asks first, then closes the game for every player

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonLobbyOptions
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageSession
wait_ms 600
activate ButtonHostSessEnd
wait_ms 600
video_mark end-armed-host
assert_label ButtonHostSessEnd Confirm end
assert_label LabelHostSessEndHint Press Confirm end to close the game for every player
assert_text_fits LabelHostSessEndHint
assert_substate HostOptions
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/armed.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 120
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/done.json 120
activate ButtonHostSessEnd
wait_substate Landing 60
video_mark session-ended-host
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/armed.json 180
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/armed.json
wait_substate Landing 180
video_mark session-ended-joiner
wait_ms 1400
exit

checklist.what: The first press of End session asks for Confirm end and names who it closes the game for.
events: ^assert_label LabelHostSessEndHint "Press Confirm end to close the game for every player".*PASS

checklist.what: The second press ends the session and the host is back at the multiplayer menu.
The joiner is back at the multiplayer menu when the host ends the session.
